summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to report that it has submitted its annual Reference Form (the Brazilian equivalent of Form 20-F) for fiscal year 2025 to the CVM. The filing is a routine periodic disclosure, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, restructuring, or other exceptional corporate event was announced. The purpose is merely to satisfy the foreign private issuer's continuous reporting obligations.
